metadata.description: Single-skill plugins for upstream skills that have no Claude route that updates on its own: either no marketplace, or one that does not update on its own in claude.ai. Every entry points at its upstream repository, pinned to the last upstream commit that changed the skill; a daily job checks each plugin and moves its pin forward, so claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code receive upstream changes and the git history records each one.

plugins.name: text-to-lottie
plugins.description: Author production-ready Lottie/Bodymovin JSON for the Skia Skottie player: SVG/logo/type animation, loaders, UI microinteractions, lower thirds, data/stat animation, product promos.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: Edit drafts into sharper, more human writing while preserving the writer's voice, or detect AI-slop patterns without rewriting.

plugins.name: marketing-os
plugins.description: An entire marketing department as one Claude skill: scored site and landing-page audits, a hook engine, graded copy, ad diagnosis, GEO, email, launches, positioning and pricing.

plugins.name: unlazy
plugins.description: Completion discipline for substantial build work: acceptance gates written before execution, a decomposed work tree, approved runnable checks, and re-verification before reporting.

plugins.name: cross-layer-drift-sweep
plugins.description: After a rename or contract change, check every downstream layer (storage, runtime, adapters, UI, docs) for stale fields, defaults, types, contracts or wording.

plugins.name: verify-all-runtime-sinks
plugins.description: Before declaring a runtime change validated, trace where each changed schema, prompt, identity, adapter, cache or renamed value is finally consumed, including alternate entry points and persisted or generated values.

plugins.name: database-lookup
plugins.description: Reproducible lookups against documented public database APIs (ClinPGx/CPIC, openFDA, DailyMed, ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD, ChEMBL, UniProt, SEC EDGAR, FRED and about seventy more) with explicit endpoints and provenance.

plugins.name: scientific-critical-thinking
plugins.description: Appraise scientific claims and evidence quality: study design validity, bias and confounding, statistical interpretation, GRADE and Cochrane risk-of-bias.

plugins.name: figma-generate-project-plan
plugins.description: Turn a PRD plus codebase context into a FigJam project-plan board, section by section, through the Figma MCP server.

plugins.name: figma-video-interaction-mapper
plugins.description: Turn a UI screen recording into an annotated Figma storyboard of interaction states. Needs ffmpeg and Python with Pillow locally.

plugins.name: design-qa
plugins.description: Compare a source design (Figma node, mockup, screenshot) against the rendered build side by side, iterate until no P0-P2 differences remain, and record the result in design-qa.md. OpenAI's Product Design helper; invoke it by name.

plugins.name: visual-verdict
plugins.description: Screenshot QA for frontend work: scores an implementation against a design reference on layout, typography, color, responsiveness, states and content, and returns PASS, REVISE or FAIL with concrete fixes.
